name: focused_region_recognition_capability_test

results.interpretation: Even with focused, label-informed questioning, the model did not see a reliable old caulk/sealant footprint or visible offset. Do not treat this as an attention-only failure.
The model can recognize the drywall hole when attention is localized. The annotation-blind failure is primarily an attention/localization problem.
The model can recognize the unfinished repair when attention is localized. The annotation-blind failure is primarily an attention/localization problem.
Even with focused, label-informed questioning, the model judged the holder as level. Do not treat this as an attention-only failure.

conclusions: Focused localization demonstrates recognition capability for defect_14 and defect_15.
The generic 42B-3 open-ended ten-view pass failed to surface those same defects, indicating an annotation-blind attention/localization failure.
Defect_10 and defect_16 remain unsupported even under label-informed focused questioning.
Additional generic prompting is unlikely to be the right next step for the two relational-geometry cases.
The geometric cases should be investigated using stronger reference geometry, alternate selected frames, or multi-frame comparison before designing a production detector path.

next_steps.step_42b4a: Annotation-blind regional attention strategy for small localized and low-contrast wall defects.
next_steps.step_42b4b: Separate multi-frame geometric-evidence investigation for toilet-base displacement and toilet-paper-holder sagging.
next_steps.performance_claim: Neither diagnostic result changes the official 3/9 verified development interval recall.
